stories.title: E-way bill generation hits record 156.21 million
stories.summary: India's e-way bill generation reached a record 156.21 million in October, a 23.14 per cent increase year-on-year. The data from the Goods and Services Tax Network reflects strong goods movement during the festive season. The previous record was 141.53 million, set just one month prior in September.

stories.title: Gram panchayats granted procurement exemption
stories.summary: The Karnataka government has allowed gram panchayats to purchase materials worth up to 5 lakh rupees per project without floating tenders. The one-year exemption aims to speed up rural development and prevent migration. There are 6,000 gram panchayats in the state eligible to use the new rule.

stories.title: India maintains status quo on broken rice exports
stories.summary: India is unlikely to impose fresh restrictions on broken rice exports despite rising international prices. The government is banking on steady paddy procurement and comfortable foodgrain stocks to ensure domestic security. India remains the world's largest rice exporter, having shipped 8.08 lakh tonnes of broken rice in 2025.

stories.title: Government expands Bharat Rice distribution
stories.summary: The Centre has doubled its target for rice sales under the Open Market Sale Scheme to 50 lakh tonnes for 2026-27. Cooperatives have been directed to expand their footprint and explore new distribution channels to ensure the accessibility of Bharat Rice. Sales have reached 25 lakh tonnes since April.

stories.title: Tea Board pauses factory licensing guidelines
stories.summary: The Tea Board has suspended its revised guidelines for new factory licenses and capacity increases in Coonoor. The decision follows protests from local manufacturers regarding restrictions on fresh applications. The rules will remain on hold while the Board conducts an internal assessment of factory capacity and leaf availability.

stories.title: India and Canada accelerate trade pact talks
stories.summary: India and Canada are fast-tracking negotiations for a free trade agreement ahead of Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s visit in December. The two sides are seeking to resolve issues regarding agricultural market access and visa quotas for workers and students. The sixth round of talks begins next week.

stories.title: Sugar production jumps fourfold
stories.summary: India's sugar production reached 12.85 lakh tonnes in the 2026-27 marketing year, a fourfold increase over the same period last year. The early start to the crushing season saw 184 mills begin operations by November 5, compared to 154 mills during the previous year's corresponding period.

stories.title: West Bengal unveils new industrial policy
stories.summary: West Bengal has launched an investment promotion policy to provide dedicated support for large-scale projects and employment-linked incentives. Finance Minister Swapan Dasgupta stated the policy aims to create a level playing field for investors. The state claims to have sufficient land to meet initial demand for three years.

stories.title: Authorities intercept 2,500 kg of suspected fake paneer
stories.summary: Food safety officials in Mathura intercepted 2,500 kg of suspected contaminated paneer arriving from Rajasthan. The consignment was ordered destroyed and the driver was arrested. Officials noted that high demand for sweets during the Diwali season often leads to an influx of substandard food products from neighbouring states.

stories.title: Government emphasizes research for coastal communities
stories.summary: The Ministry of Earth Sciences is focusing on translating scientific research into practical solutions for coastal and marginalised communities. Secretary T Srinivasa Kumar stated the government is committed to using technological advancements to address climate change vulnerabilities. The initiative was highlighted at a recent international symposium on fisheries.

stories.title: Sensex reclaims 80,000 milestone
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex crossed the 80,000 mark for the first time since March 5, 2026, despite a global technology-led sell-off. The index touched an intraday high of 80,080 before settling. The Nifty 50 also advanced, showing resilience against the pressure affecting global equities.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty reach nine-month highs
stories.summary: Benchmark indices recorded a seventh day of gains on Friday, with the Sensex climbing 1,718 points to close at 81,028. The Nifty regained the 25,000 level for the first time in nine months. Investors were boosted by foreign fund inflows, easing crude oil prices and strong corporate earnings.

stories.title: Markets close Samvat on a high
stories.summary: The Sensex and Nifty ended Samvat 2082 with annual losses of 4 per cent and 3.1 per cent, marking their weakest performance since 2011. Despite the annual decline, the indices finished the year with their strongest weekly gains in nearly six years, driven by a late rally.

stories.title: Foreign investors drive record weekly market gains
stories.summary: Indian equities recorded their strongest weekly gains in nearly six years, with foreign investors purchasing a record 45,960 crore rupees of stock. The rally occurred despite a global sell-off in artificial intelligence shares. Domestic institutional investors recorded their largest-ever weekly net outflow of 24,197 crore rupees.

stories.title: Indian markets decouple from global tech rout
stories.summary: Indian markets closed sharply higher on Friday, with the Sensex gaining 1,718 points and the Nifty reclaiming the 25,000 mark. Analysts described the performance as a rare decoupling from the global market rout. For the week, the indices posted some of their strongest gains in recent years.

stories.title: Domestic investors cushion record foreign outflows
stories.summary: Foreign portfolio investors withdrew a record 4.55 trillion rupees from Indian equities during Samvat 2082. Domestic institutional investors countered the trend with record net purchases of 8.55 trillion rupees. The market remained resilient despite global turmoil and a shift in portfolios toward artificial intelligence firms.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty record strongest weekly rally since 2021
stories.summary: Indian benchmark indices surged nearly 9 percent for the week ending November 6, 2026. The rally added 28.70 trillion rupees to investor wealth, supported by broad buying across banking and consumer sectors. It marks the strongest weekly performance for the indices since February 2021.

stories.title: Stock markets post biggest weekly gains in five years
stories.summary: Indian markets rose for seven consecutive sessions, adding 29.57 trillion rupees to investor wealth. The Sensex and Nifty recorded their strongest weekly performance in over five years, closing at their highest levels in eight months. The rally persisted despite a global technology sell-off affecting Asian markets.

stories.title: Equities extend winning streak to seven sessions
stories.summary: Indian benchmark indices recorded their sharpest weekly gains in recent years, with the Nifty50 reclaiming the 25,000 mark. The rally was supported by foreign inflows and strong corporate earnings. Softening US bond yields and a global sell-off in AI-linked stocks also influenced investor sentiment ahead of Diwali.

stories.title: Sunday PropTech acquires Kolkata hotel
stories.summary: Sunday PropTech has acquired an 89-room hotel in Rajarhat, Kolkata, marking its entry into the Eastern India hospitality market. The company plans to rebrand the property under its Clubhouse label. It intends to improve operational performance using the technology and revenue management capabilities of its backer, PRISM.

stories.title: DLF plans 3,750 crore rupee investment in joint venture
stories.summary: DLF plans to invest 3,750 crore rupees for a majority stake in a joint venture with Everstone. The partnership aims to invest in IREO India companies and enhance governance within the existing business framework. Completion of the transaction is expected by next year.

stories.title: Marico to acquire majority stake in Bonorizon
stories.summary: Marico will acquire a 51 percent stake in Bonorizon Consumer Ventures for 35 crore rupees in an all-cash deal. The FMCG company retains the right to purchase the remaining equity after three years. The move is part of a strategy to strengthen its international business operations.

stories.title: Lenskart sees 1,896 crore rupee block deal
stories.summary: SVF II Lightbulb has sold a 1.6 percent stake in Lenskart for 1,896 crore rupees. Buyers in the transaction included Societe Generale, Goldman Sachs, and Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund. The shares were sold at 697.15 rupees apiece, according to BSE block deal data.

stories.title: MakeMyTrip enters ride-pooling with Quick Ride acquisition
stories.summary: MakeMyTrip has acquired a majority stake in shared mobility platform Quick Ride. The ride-pooling operations will be housed under a new entity, Co Ride Mobility. Quick Ride promoters will continue to lead the business, while the company's electric vehicle taxi operations remain with the predecessor firm.

stories.title: Singapore court orders seizure of Tata Power shares
stories.summary: The Singapore International Commercial Court has authorised the seizure and sale of Tata Power shares in two subsidiaries. The order aims to satisfy a judgment debt exceeding 6,113 crore rupees owed to Kleros Capital Partners. The firm is an investment advisory based in the British Virgin Islands.

stories.title: Share India Securities to merge with Ace Alpha Tech
stories.summary: Share India Securities has approved a scheme of amalgamation to absorb Ace Alpha Tech. The board of directors approved the merger on November 6, 2026. The transaction remains subject to statutory and regulatory approvals. The company stated the deal is not classified as a related party transaction.

stories.summary: MakeMyTrip acquires majority stake in Quick Ride to enter ride pooling The acquisition will help MakeMyTrip expand into shared mobility, covering daily urban commutes and intercity travel, while complementing its existing ground transport portfolio. stories.title: Tech Mahindra to increase stake in Pininfarina
stories.summary: Tech Mahindra plans to increase its stake in Italian design firm Pininfarina to 92.59 percent. Its subsidiary, PF Holdings, will acquire an additional 10.02 percent for up to 9.46 million euros. The company disclosed the commitment in an exchange filing on Friday.

stories.title: Transparency as a dairy market differentiator
stories.summary: India produces more milk than any other country, accounting for nearly a quarter of global output. Industry observers argue that the sector suffers from anonymity, which complicates accountability. The proposed solution is to fix anonymity to address the broader dairy conversation. The cows remain silent on the matter.

stories.title: Diamond industry eyes transparency to sustain demand
stories.summary: India’s gems and jewellery market is projected to reach ₹11,18,390 crore by 2030. Industry participants suggest that sustaining this growth requires confidence in the information underpinning transactions. As natural and laboratory-grown diamonds proliferate, accurate disclosure is being framed as the primary tool for maintaining consumer trust.

stories.title: Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football
stories.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his retirement from international football, ending a 23-year career. The forward, who holds the record for most international goals, will continue playing club football for Al-Nassr. His international legacy is now officially a matter of record.

stories.title: Supreme Court judge suggests contract roles for government staff
stories.summary: Justice BV Nagarathna suggested that government employees should be recruited on a contractual basis to ensure accountability. During a hearing regarding unpaid arrears, the judge described government staff as a privileged class. The court noted that current productivity levels involve typing three pages a day.

stories.title: NBFC credit for gold and durables surges
stories.summary: Non-banking finance companies saw credit for gold jewellery rise 66.1 percent to ₹3.74 lakh crore in September 2026. Credit for consumer durables increased 54.4 percent to ₹77,896 crore. The Reserve Bank of India reported the growth, which occurred over the span of one year.

stories.title: GPF rules clarified for deceased employees
stories.summary: The Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions issued a memorandum regarding General Provident Fund balances. The rules state that nominations for non-family members cannot override the rights of surviving family. The government continues to manage the distribution of funds for its employees.

stories.title: SEBI proposes mandatory AML certification for officers
stories.summary: SEBI has proposed mandatory anti-money laundering and terrorism financing certification for principal officers at registered intermediaries. Officers must clear the NISM-Series-XXIV examination within six months of the requirement. The regulator is currently seeking to standardise compliance knowledge across the industry.

stories.title: SEBI considers two-year dormancy rule for demat accounts
stories.summary: SEBI is discussing a uniform two-year dormancy period for demat accounts to prevent potential misuse. The proposal would require investors to complete verification formalities before resuming transactions if their account remains inactive for two years. The regulator is currently consulting with exchanges and brokers.

stories.title: The financial risks of acting as a loan guarantor
stories.summary: Acting as a loan guarantor is a legally binding agreement to repay debt if a borrower defaults. Banks often require a guarantor when a borrower fails to meet credit score requirements. The obligation can outlast the friendship that prompted the initial request.

stories.title: Landlord ordered to refund security deposit with interest
stories.summary: A Bengaluru consumer commission ordered a landlord to return an ₹80,000 security deposit after a tenant vacated the property. The landlord was also directed to pay 9 percent annual interest and ₹10,000 in litigation costs. The commission found no evidence of property damage or outstanding dues.

stories.title: MSMEs explore AI as a strategic consultant
stories.summary: Agraiya co-founder Raman Thigarajan demonstrated how MSMEs can use AI as a strategic advisor through four frameworks. The masterclass covered applications in manufacturing, employee retention, and operational efficiency. The session suggested that AI can act as a sparring partner for business decision-making.

stories.title: RBI guidelines on loan recovery agent conduct
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has updated guidelines regarding loan recovery agents. While lenders have the right to recover dues, agents are prohibited from using intimidation, public humiliation, or workplace harassment. Borrowers are advised that professional reputation remains protected under these terms.
